title: Phase 3: validate command
objective: Implement `fake-jev validate <path>` so every statically checkable configuration rule runs without starting a server or touching the network.
acceptance: exit 2 on any configuration or schema violation, 0 on success
no network request and no listener is created
nextAction: run fresh specifier, then coder, cleaner, hardener, and QA stages
notes: scope amendment 2026-09-29 (PM): §15.2 requires a `fake-jev validate <path>` command, but the CLI routes commands in internal/cli/dispatch.go, which was not in allowedFiles. Added internal/cli/dispatch.go (and its usage text) so the command is actually reachable. No new public behavior beyond §15.2/§42.1.

ownership split 2026-09-29 (PM, owner-approved option 2): C-CLI-005's "all static checks" is delivered in two parts. FJ-030 owns the configuration/schema surface (top-level schema, unknown fields, duplicate ids, expect rules, response-form exactness) via the shared internal/config validator. FJ-059 owns the statically provable jev/v1 fixture-data checks: the inner then.answers payload rules (finite probabilities, ranges, maps summing to 1.0 within 1e-6) and the when.questions to then.answers key-set cross-check. Reason for the split: those checks live in the jev/v1 compat layer, and internal/config must stay provider-neutral (cmd/guard arch forbids the import), so they cannot be implemented inside FJ-030's allowedFiles without forking the semantics. Choice/score criterion key-set equality is not statically decidable because criteria come from the request. FJ-030 records these two gaps explicitly rather than accepting them silently.
